what: Each time the pointer enters, a translucent band tilted at 110° (only 10% of the text remains at its center) sweeps once from left to right through a mask over 1.5s (power1.out), so the text fades and returns as if submerged and revealed by a current. While hovered it is pressed down to .98x over .5s ease-out. Even if the pointer leaves, the band finishes passing

options.from · to: Where the band center passes (% of element width, band center = 50% + value), default -200 · 200 — Brand -100 · 100
options.--fx-angle: Band angle (via style), default 110deg — Brand 90deg (vertical band)
options.--fx-depth: Text density left at the band center (via style), default 10% — Brand 50%
options.--fx-spread: Distance over which darkness returns from the band center to both sides (% of element width, via style), default 150% — Brand 45%

from.where: index.html header menu · awards · media list rows · bottom row links — original .sinking-link (mask --gradient-offset -200% → 200%, 1.5s · :hover scale .98 .5s ease-out)

shared.css .dk-hv (original c-hv-op — a semi-transparent vertical band in the center of a 300%×100% mask PNG (faintest .5) moves right 0 → right 100% over 2.8s cubic-bezier(.08,1,.3,1), on each menu button · contents row · link · table map link). No pressed state
